mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sales_override (product_id, branch_id, status, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId}), #{status}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, BIN_TO_UUID(branch_id) AS branch_id, status, created_at FROM product_sales_override WHERE branch_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId}) AND product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_sales_override WHERE branch_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId}) AND product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})
